name: Auth0
description: Auth0 is an authentication and authorization platform (an Okta product) that the vendor describes as "an easy to implement, adaptable authentication and authorization platform" for integrating identity into applications.
best_for: Serves developers building consumer apps, internal tools, and enterprise software, plus startups, enterprises needing SSO/SCIM/multi-tenancy, and B2B/B2C SaaS companies.
features: Auth0 for AI Agents (async authorization, RAG pipeline controls)

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: Auth0's parent-company workforce identity platform, providing SSO and adaptive MFA for employees/partners across 8,000+ integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises managing internal workforce access rather than embedding customer-facing auth into an app.

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: Provides a credential vault and secrets management platform rather than a developer authentication API.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing a shared vault for passwords/secrets rather than building login flows into their own product.
